name: Alchemist Potionslinger
body:
A potionslinger is an alchemist who delivers his extracts, potions, and poisons through his dart gun.

Injection Gun (Su)

A potionslinger begins game owning a specially modified timeworn dart gun. The potionslinger can charge extracts he creates into darts and fire them to a victim. A creature hit by an injection gun is affected by a charged extract or other liquid, even if it was meant to be imbibed, as per the touch injection spell; fired extracts are considered infused for this purpose, even if the alchemist does not possess the infusion discovery. Discoveries that affect extracts can normally be applied to extracts administered through a dart gun.

Only the alchemist knows how to use his injection gun properly; it will glitch as normal in the hands of everyone else. Other creatures cannot use the injection gun to deliver extracts, or to deliver other liquids meant to be imbibed.

This replaces poison use.

Ready, Steady, Fire

The potionslinger gains Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms) as a bonus feat.

This replaces throw anything.

Technology Expert

A potionslinger alchemist can select the Technologist feat or any feat with Technologist as a prerequisite in place of a discovery.

Quick Recharge (Ex)

At 3rd level, a potionslinger can pour a dose of a pharmaceutical, drug, or poison, a potion, or an extract into his injection gun’s reservoir as a move action. At 6th level, he can do it as a swift action, and at 18th level, as an immediate action.

This replaces swift poisoning and modifies swift alchemy and instant alchemy.

Discoveries

These discoveries complement the potionslinger archetype: bottled ooze, celestial poisons, combine extracts, concentrate poison, designer poison, elemental destabilizers, enduring toxin, explosive missile, infusion, malignant poison, pickled quasit, poison conversion, precise poison, remedy extract, sticky poison, and all the bomb discoveries. A potionslinger also has access to the following unique discovery:

Mutagenic Shot (Su)

The alchemist can pour a modified version of his mutagen into his dart gun’s reservoir, so that it is injected into a target’s body with a successful hit. A mutagen so modified works just like a standard mutagen, except the natural armor bonus and the alchemical bonus to the ability score are half normal (+1 natural armor bonus and +2 to one ability score). A mutagenic shot has no risk of nauseating a target. The alchemist can shot himself with a modified mutagen, only gaining the reduced bonus.
